description: This PHP source file defines the SkillDao class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and searches related to 'Skill' entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching skills, leveraging Doctrine ORM features.

classes.name: SkillDao
classes.description: Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing Skill entities in the database, providing methods to save, retrieve, delete, and search skills.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Persists a Skill entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill entity by its ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingSkillIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing Skill IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple Skills identified by their IDs.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for Skills based on filter parameters and returns matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchSkillPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for Skill search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Skills matching the given search parameters.
